top_signals.title: Iran attack on base in Jordan damaged American military aircraft, US official says
top_signals.summary: Iranian strikes damaged one A-10 Thunderbolt II and eight F-15s this week on the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Former Sega president recalls being ‘impressed’ with Nvidia’s Huong
top_signals.summary: Shoichiro Irimajiri said he had decided to invest $5 million in Nvidia in the late 1990s because he was impressed by its CEO, Jensen Huang.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
